description: This file defines a class EmailsViewImport which extends ViewEdit, responsible for handling the import view of emails within the SuiteCRM module. It sets up options to hide various UI elements, manages pre-display conditions, and assigns template variables related to email import functionality.

classes.name: EmailsViewImport
classes.description: A view class for handling email import interface in SuiteCRM, customizing display options and managing pre-display setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes view options to hide the title, header, footer, JavaScript, subpanels, and search; sets view type to 'ImportView'.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering, assigning variables such as INBOUND_ID, TEMP_ID, and return module/action to the view's template engine.
